description: Makes short videos with AI: an idea becomes a narrated, captioned video, and a long video becomes clips for TikTok, Reels and Shorts.

pricing.details: Free: 1 hour of AI clipping per month, no card. Pro 15 €/month official EU price (10 AI videos + 5 hours of processing); 50% off the first month until 1 December 2026 (promo euro amount not published, so not shown). Single AI video 2.49 € one-time (official EU price). A different non-EU list price also appears in the page title; it is recorded only in the official-currency notes and is not shown here.
